newsitem.title: USA: US Commerce Dept seeks agency for census ads.
newsitem.headline: US Commerce Dept seeks agency for census ads.

text.p: The U.S. Commerce Department said Thursday that it was seeking at least one advertising agency for a $100 million contract to produce its Census 2000 advertising campaign.
The department's Census Bureau will award the contract by late summer for its next decennial census. The deadline for the initial response is January 10.
"We believe a paid advertising campaign will have the greatest impact for Census 2000," Census Bureau Director Martha Fansworth Riche said in a written statement.
A prototype of the campaign is scheduled for spring 1998.
